purpose: Two explainable matched follow-ups: weight-magnitude versus loss-ablation ranking, and batch-normalization mode during recovery
context: Previous 192-channel ablation and expanded tuning results have already been inspected; these comparisons are exploratory, not independent confirmation.
first_comparison: Prune the first decoder from 200 to 192 with the existing downstream pointwise L1-weight score; compare against the prior 192-channel ablation-score candidate and original control. Use frozen BN for one epoch.
second_comparison: Train the existing 192-channel ablation candidate with normal BN mode for one epoch, comparing against its prior frozen-BN run. Mode changes both statistics used in forward/backward and updates to running buffers; affine parameters remain trainable in both.

common_settings.loss: mean absolute error on finite positive target pixels

selection_note: No held-out 654-image candidate comparisons. The tuning set has been inspected repeatedly and has only two scenes; no Orin claim.
